title: US x Iran ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran announced on April 7, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between the United States and Iran, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 7 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect. 

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the United States government and the government of Iran that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed two-week period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the United States government and the government of Iran. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

title: Fed decision in April?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's April 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for April 28-29, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their April meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

Headline CPI surged 3.3% year-over-year—up sharply from February's 2.4%—driven by energy costs, while nonfarm payrolls added 178,000 jobs and unemployment dipped to 4.3%, signaling a firm labor market with no urgency for cuts or hikes. Fed officials, including Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, have affirmed the current 3.5%-3.75% stance as well-positioned, with March minutes showing scant appetite for near-term adjustments despite one projected 2026 cut later. Realistic challenges include hotter-than-expected April data revisions or geopolitical shocks prompting a surprise pivot, ahead of tomorrow's policy announcement and Chair Powell's press conference.

title: Israel x Hezbollah Ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah announced on April 16, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between Israel and Hezbollah, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 16 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect.

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the Israeli government and Hezbollah that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed 10-day period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the Israeli government and Hezbollah. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' overwhelming early-2026 pace has propelled teammates George Russell and Kimi Antonelli to the top of trader consensus for the F1 Drivers' Championship, with Russell at 41.5% implied probability reflecting his experience edge and Australia Grand Prix win, while Antonelli's 32.6% stems from his maiden China victory and dominant Japanese GP triumph that vaulted him to the standings lead on 72 points over Russell's 63. Recent post-Japan developments, including Russell's admissions of needing consistency amid intra-team rivalry and Antonelli's sophomore surge in qualifying and race pace, underscore the duo's podium locks amid Ferrari's Charles Leclerc (49 points, 7%) and others trailing due to inferior machinery. Rivals like Max Verstappen face steep recovery paths as Mercedes exploits superior energy management and straight-line speed.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as the frontrunner at 49% for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, ahead of Vice President J.D. Vance at 39% and Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 22%, driven by RFK Jr.'s high-profile role as HHS Secretary and his Make America Healthy Again movement resonating with the GOP base following his 2024 Trump endorsement. Recent Yale and CPAC straw polls from mid-April show Vance leading Republican voters at 43% with Rubio second, highlighting a divergence between polling averages and prediction market odds where traders emphasize RFK Jr.'s outsider appeal amid Vance's exposure to foreign policy setbacks like failed Iran negotiations. With President Trump term-limited, the open primary field remains fluid ahead of 2026 midterms that could clarify frontrunners through turnout in swing states and battleground primaries.

title: Trump Today: April 25
description: This is a market over what Donald Trump will do on April 25, 2026.

markets.question: Will Trump dance today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump dances between 12:00AM ET and 11:59PM ET on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

AI-generated content, deepfakes, or altered footage will not be considered. 

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

This market will resolve based on video.

markets.question: Will Trump wear a red tie today?

The color will be determined by the most visually dominant color visible in publicly available photos or videos. This tie would count as "Blue": https://i.ytimg.com/vi/20w7J2JAmqw/maxresdefault.jpg

The following tie has no distinguishable predominant color, and thus would resolve to "No". https://www.usatoday.com/gcdn/authoring/authoring-images/2025/01/20/USAT/77837111007-xxx-dcmg-105-5190802.jpg

markets.question: Will Trump sign an executive order today?

Executive actions will not qualify toward this market’s resolution.

If no executive order is published by 12:00 PM ET the day after the listed date of this market, this market will resolve to “No”.

In the case of ambiguity this market may remain open until it is confirmed by the federal register.

markets.question: Will Trump say "Sleepy Joe" today?
markets.description:

Plural and possessive forms of the listed term will count toward the resolution of this market regardless of context; however, other forms will NOT count.

Instances where the term is used in a compound word will count regardless of context (e.g., joyful is not a compound word for "joy," however, "killjoy" is a compounding of the words "kill" and "joy").

If this market requires a specified number of mentions of a person’s first or last name, a full-name mention will count as one mention (e.g., if a market is about “Joe / Biden 5+ times,” a mention of “Joe Biden” will count once).

A ‘mention’ will include any verbal mention which is recorded (audio or video) and publicly accessible.

Written usages of terms (e.g. Truth Social posts, written statements, etc.) will not count toward this market's resolution.

AI-generated audio or video will not count toward this market's resolution.

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Iran's April 27 proposal to the US—offering to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, extend the ceasefire, and end hostilities while postponing nuclear negotiations—marks the latest diplomatic push amid the fragile Pakistan-mediated truce from April 8, now under strain after stalled Islamabad talks on April 11-12. Core sticking points persist, including Iran's nuclear enrichment, ballistic missiles, and US sanctions, with President Trump signaling red lines and limited optimism for quick resolution. Trader consensus reflects low near-term odds for a permanent peace deal, prioritizing interim measures over comprehensive treaty amid risks of escalation if proposals falter. Upcoming US response and potential further mediation in Pakistan could shift dynamics before the ceasefire deadline.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket gives California Gov. Gavin Newsom a leading 27.1% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, driven by his executive experience, surging donor base exceeding 100,000 new contributors since late 2025, and top electability ratings in an April Echelon Insights poll (43% deem him "very electable"). This edges out Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's 9.0% progressive appeal and former VP Kamala Harris's 7.5% name recognition, hampered by her 2024 loss, amid a fragmented field lacking a clear frontrunner in recent national surveys like McLaughlin's April poll showing Harris at 29%. Consolidation could follow 2026 midterm outcomes boosting standout governors like Newsom or Pennsylvania's Josh Shapiro, alongside sustained fundraising and polling gains before primaries begin in 2028.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 21 - April 28, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 21 12:00 PM ET to April 28, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus slightly favors Paris Saint-Germain at home in this UEFA Champions League semi-final first leg at Parc des Princes, reflecting their near-full-strength squad amid Bayern Munich's injury crisis and managerial suspension. Bayern miss key attackers Serge Gnabry (adductor tear) and Raphaël Guerreiro (hamstring), plus midfielders Lennart Karl and Tom Bischof, with Vincent Kompany sidelined after a yellow-card accumulation from the Real Madrid tie, thinning defensive options like Josip Stanišić and Konrad Laimer. PSG hold a clean bill barring Vitinha's heel doubt, leveraging Achraf Hakimi and Nuno Mendes' returns alongside Fabián Ruiz's fitness. Bayern's recent stunning comeback underscores their scoring threat under Harry Kane, while head-to-head history (Bayern 9-7 lead) and similar possession styles keep probabilities tightly bunched, with draw viable in a tactical opener.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's January nomination of former Fed Governor Kevin Warsh to succeed Jerome Powell as Federal Reserve Chair, whose term expires May 15, has solidified trader consensus at 98.8% following key recent breakthroughs. On April 21, Warsh testified before the Senate Banking Committee, vowing monetary policy independence and rejecting White House pressure on rates, addressing Democratic concerns over asset disclosures exceeding $100 million. Critically, Sen. Thom Tillis lifted his hold on April 26 after the Justice Department closed its probe into Powell, clearing the path for a full Senate vote amid strong GOP backing. While late Democratic opposition or undisclosed conflicts could theoretically derail confirmation, procedural momentum points to swift approval.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Despite ongoing U.S. and Israeli airstrikes crippling infrastructure and exacerbating economic freefall—evident in recent Reuters reports of shattered factories and desperation—IRGC forces remain loyal, with no verified mass defections or renewed uprisings in the past month. Ceasefire talks stalling as of April 28 underscore regime resilience amid sanctions and oil disruptions. Realistic shifts would require a black-swan event like Supreme Leader incapacitation or uncontainable internal revolt.

title: Madrid Open: Stefanos Tsitsipas vs Casper Ruud
description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Stefanos Tsitsipas and Casper Ruud in the Madrid Open, originally scheduled for April 28, 2026 at 8:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Stefanos Tsitsipas' if Stefanos Tsitsipas advances against Casper Ruud.

This market will resolve to 'Casper Ruud' if Casper Ruud advances against Stefanos Tsitsipas.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Casper Ruud, the defending Madrid Open champion and No. 12 seed, dominates early rounds on home clay with straight-set wins, dropping just five games total, reinforcing his clay-court prowess amid a top-15 ATP ranking. Stefanos Tsitsipas, rebounding from an eight-year ranking low near No. 80 and recent losses, advanced convincingly 6-4, 6-2 over qualifier Daniel Merida yesterday, rediscovering confidence on the high-altitude surface where his one-handed backhand thrives. Ruud leads their tight 3-2 head-to-head, including a recent Barcelona clay victory, though no fresh injuries cloud either—Ruud's prior calf tweak or Tsitsipas' form surge—setting a competitive ATP Masters 1000 round-of-16 battle with quarterfinal implications.

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $160 in April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point during April 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For WTI futures, the active month refers to the nearest listed contract month. The active month changes at 6:00:00 PM ET at the start of the trading session two business days prior to that contract's last trading day, at which point the next listed contract becomes the active month.

For WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, the last trading day is defined as three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day), consistent with CME contract specifications.

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours as listed on Pyth.

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles.

Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim lead in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election at 18.9%, reflecting his strong positioning as the Republican heir apparent following his CPAC straw poll victory in late March and a recent UMass Lowell poll showing him edging California Governor Gavin Newsom 33%-30%. Newsom trails closely at 17.6% as the implied Democratic frontrunner amid an open primary field post-Harris, buoyed by his national profile despite California's fiscal challenges. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 11.6% share has risen on his handling of Iran tensions and Venezuela policy in recent weeks, fueling GOP donor "draft Rubio" efforts. With 2026 midterms looming, party control of Congress and turnout in swing states could widen gaps, alongside Trump endorsements or scandals.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's "Liekinheitin" by violinist Linda Lampenius and pop star Pete Parkkonen commands a 36% implied probability as the clear frontrunner, driven by its explosive fusion of classical flair and anthemic hooks that dominated UMK national final voting in late February and has topped fan polls like My Eurovision Scoreboard (320,000+ points as of April 27). Trader consensus reflects sustained televote momentum amid the full lineup reveal, though jury odds lag, capping its lead. Denmark's heartfelt ballad "Før vi går hjem" by Søren Torpegaard Lund holds steady at 12% post-Melodi Grand Prix win, buoyed by emotional resonance. Greece's Akylas surged to 11% with last week's "Super Ferto" remix boosting streams, while France's chic pop "Regarde!" by Monroe sits at 10%. With stand-in rehearsals underway and official ones starting May 2 ahead of Vienna semis on May 12/14, staging reveals could spark shifts in this crowded field.

title: Trump announces end of military operations against Iran by ...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: A fragile two-week US-Iran ceasefire, effective since April 8 and brokered by Pakistan, remains in place despite strains over Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz, where Tehran detains vessels and demands an end to the US naval blockade. President Trump declared core military objectives—destroying Iranian missiles, navy assets, and proxy support—nearly complete in early April addresses, suspending airstrikes to pursue negotiations while intensifying economic sanctions. Recent diplomatic talks stalled as of April 26, with Iran rejecting discussions under pressure and exploiting Hormuz leverage; low prospects for compromise persist amid Netanyahu's security consultations. Traders eye potential White House announcements shifting fully from kinetic operations, though naval standoffs and escalation risks linger.

title: Indian Premier League: Punjab Kings vs Rajasthan Royals
description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Punjab Kings and Rajasthan Royals scheduled for April 28 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

If the match is abandoned, ends in No Result, is permanently canceled, or otherwise concludes without an official result, the market will resolve No.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed or permanently canceled, after which it will resolve as described above.

eventMetadata.context_description: Punjab Kings hold the IPL summit with 13 points from seven matches on a seven-game unbeaten streak—including a recent six-wicket chase over Delhi Capitals—fueled by explosive batting from Prabhsimran Singh and Marcus Stoinis, positioning traders to favor their home dominance at batting paradise Maharaja Yadavindra Singh Stadium in Mullanpur. Average first-innings scores exceed 190 here with true bounce suiting stroke-makers, though spinners may grip later. Rajasthan Royals, fourth with 10 points but reeling from a Sunrisers Hyderabad loss that cost them top spot, rely on Riyan Parag's leadership and pacers Jofra Archer plus Nandre Burger to counter PBKS firepower; RR won the toss electing to bowl but face a steep 223 chase after PBKS posted 222/4. No major injuries reported, heightening matchup intrigue between PBKS momentum and RR's desperation for playoffs push.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count.

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Amid an ongoing US-Iran conflict over the Strait of Hormuz now in its eighth week, Pakistan-mediated negotiations have driven recent diplomatic momentum despite persistent hurdles. Vice President JD Vance's high-level talks in Islamabad earlier this month marked the first direct US-Iran government contacts since 1979, achieving partial progress on ceasefire terms but stalling without agreement. Iran proposed an interim deal on April 27 to reopen the strait and defer nuclear discussions, prompting US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to head to Pakistan for a potential second round. Tehran blames excessive US demands for prior failures, insists on indirect channels, and has deepened ties with Russia and China, while a UN clash highlighted tensions over Iran's nuclear non-proliferation role. President Trump canceled direct talks last week, underscoring fragility ahead of any formal diplomatic meeting.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices an 80.5% chance that Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic will not return to normal by May 15, reflecting persistent disruptions from the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and Tehran's retaliatory restrictions amid stalled diplomacy. As of April 27, only seven vessels—mostly dry bulk—transited in 24 hours, far below pre-crisis volumes of over 100 daily, following Iran's seizure of two ships on April 22 despite a brief ceasefire extension. Failed short-lived reopenings earlier in April, coupled with ongoing hostilities in the Iran conflict, signal no de-escalation before the deadline, with shippers avoiding the chokepoint due to escalation risks and absent U.S.-Iran agreements.

title: LoL: Weibo Gaming vs Top Esports (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Weibo Gaming and Top Esports in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for April 28 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Weibo Gaming" if Weibo Gaming win the match against Top Esports.

This market will resolve to "Top Esports" if Top Esports win the match against Weibo Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Weibo Gaming and Top Esports each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Top Esports enters as the Group Ascend frontrunner at 6-1 overall (12-2 maps), riding a dominant streak with 2-0 sweeps over BLG, JDG, AL, and IG in recent weeks, fueled by standout performances from top laner ZUIAN, jungler Tian, and ADC JackeyLove in the current meta favoring early skirmishes and objective control. Weibo Gaming sits mid-table after a 2-0 loss to BLG and 1-2 defeat to AL last week, though they notched a clean 2-0 over WE; their roster with Zika top, Jiejie jungle, Xiaohu mid, Elk ADC, and Hang support shows inconsistency in mid-game transitions. Head-to-head history tilts TES 11-5, but WBG's aggressive jungle plays could exploit any TES overextension in this double round-robin BO3, where top-4 finish secures direct playoffs entry. Trader consensus reflects TES's momentum and home-like crowd edge in Shanghai.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects near-certain 99.7% implied probability against Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic normalizing by April 30, driven by persistent US naval blockades and Iranian retaliations amid the 2026 Iran war. MarineTraffic data shows transits at 3-8 vessels daily—under 10% of the pre-crisis 130-vessel average—following failed ceasefires, ship seizures, and attacks as recent as April 23. No diplomatic progress has materialized in the past week despite brief reopenings like Iran's April 17 declaration, sustaining deterrence from shoot-to-kill rules and mine threats. Tail risks include a sudden US-Iran deal or unilateral de-escalation before month's end, though stalemated nuclear talks diminish prospects, amplifying crude oil futures volatility.

eventMetadata.context_description: Boston Celtics hold a commanding 3-1 series lead over the Philadelphia 76ers entering Game 5 at TD Garden, where they posted a 31-12 home record this season, fueling trader consensus toward a closeout. The Celtics' 128-96 Game 4 rout on April 26 featured Payton Pritchard's playoff career-high 32 points off the bench and franchise-record three-point volume, exposing Philadelphia's defensive lapses even with Joel Embiid's return. Embiid, probable tonight after appendectomy recovery, scored modestly in his debut back, while Kelly Oubre Jr. is off the injury report and Boston lists no players. Facing elimination, the 76ers must harness Tyrese Maxey's scoring and road resilience against Boston's elite defense and home-court edge in this Eastern Conference first-round clash.
